headline: Names a Miami, Florida post office building after Father Richard Marquess-Barry.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building at 18640 NW 2nd Avenue in Miami, Florida. The building will be officially called the "Father Richard Marquess-Barry Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 19, 2014.
